description: Update the project rejection-alert threshold or idle-app window using its existing settings API. Omitted settings and the webhook destination stay unchanged. threshold counts rejections per app in ten minutes (5–1000); idle_days flags apps after 1–90 idle days, never revokes them. Requires the owner key or an admin member key. Returns current alert settings; does not rename or delete the project.

admin_key.description: The project owner key (ga_...) or an admin member key (gm_...). Never print it.

idle_days.description: Idle days before flagging an app; never revokes it.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

threshold.description: Rejections per app within ten minutes that trigger an alert.

name: gate_update_project
title: Update project alert settings
